name: 客室の条件と割引前後の合計を読む宿泊検索の行
prompt:
Create one polished Japanese hotel-result row for catalog ID LH01-0136, “客室の条件と割引前後の合計を読む宿泊検索の行”. The original Booking.com screen controls the two-column layout, photo area, information order and price hierarchy. The existing Japanese mock controls the localized content and Japanese presentation. Preserve the exact original hotel-room photograph and the mock’s photo crop; do not redraw the room, change its lighting, colors, objects, or perspective, or invent a replacement image. If the provided photograph cannot be preserved exactly, keep its visible scene and crop as close as possible and do not add any new property imagery.

Render one standalone listing row on a white 390x410-proportion canvas, with the hotel photograph as a tall rounded rectangle on the left and the information column on the right. Keep the saved heart outline at the top-right. Do not add an outer card border, surrounding results page, phone frame, unrelated cards, or Booking.com / Genius brand logos.

Use exactly the following Japanese copy and numbers:
施設名: 東京のレジデンス
星: four outlined stars
会員バッジ: 会員特典
評価: 8.3
評価文: とても良い
口コミ: 76件の口コミ
所在地: 荒川区・中心部から8.2km
客室種別と面積: アパートメント・32m²
ベッドと寝室: ベッド3台・寝室1室
浴室: バスルーム1室
一泊: 1泊 ¥ 9,600
合計見出し: 2泊の合計
割引前合計: ¥ 36,000, shown struck through
割引後合計: ¥ 19,200, visually strongest in the price group

Keep the photo left and property details right. Show the four stars as restrained green outlines and the 会員特典 badge in forest green. Put 8.3 in a compact green rating tile, with the rating phrase and review count beside or below it. Use a quiet outline location pin. Keep the room details and prices compact; show the crossed-out old total before the stronger ¥19,200 total without introducing a new discount percentage or claim.

Use Meiryo, Bold 20/28 px for the property name, Regular 14/24 px for primary details and Metadata 12/16 px for supporting price labels, with tracking 0. Use ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E, supporting icons #526173, and Lighthouse Brand #1F6444 for green accents. Preserve a white background and generous image clarity. Keep all details readable at the target size. Do not add amenities, ratings, claims, stars, review counts, or prices beyond those listed.
reviewNotes: Agent visual review: the layout and Japanese property/price details are strong. Needs correction because the room photo was resynthesized; its lamp arrangement and room details differ from the original photo in the source/mock. Preserve the original photo and crop. This is a candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
